title: Software Developer Learning Roadmap
description: A comprehensive step-by-step path from programming fundamentals to writing production software.

steps.title: Learn Core Programming Fundamentals
steps.description: Master programming logic, control structures, data types, and functions using JavaScript or Python.

steps.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
steps.description: Understand arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, searching, and sorting algorithms.

steps.title: Version Control & Git Workflow
steps.description: Learn Git commands, branching, merging, GitHub workflows, and team collaboration.

steps.title: Object-Oriented & Functional Design
steps.description: Apply clean code principles, SOLID design patterns, and unit testing.

steps.title: Build Real-World Portfolio Projects
steps.description: Develop and deploy full applications, write unit tests, and showcase projects on GitHub.

title: Full-Stack Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Master end-to-end web engineering, from responsive UI design to REST API backends and database management.

steps.title: Front-End Foundation (HTML, CSS, Modern JS)
steps.description: Master semantic HTML5, CSS Flexbox/Grid, and ES6+ JavaScript syntax.

steps.title: Front-End Framework (React.js)
steps.description: Learn component state, props, hooks, routing, and state management.

steps.title: Back-End Server Architecture (Node.js & Express)
steps.description: Build RESTful APIs, handle HTTP authentication, and design middleware routing.

steps.title: Databases & ORM/ODM (MongoDB & Mongoose)
steps.description: Design database schemas, write aggregation pipelines, and index collections.

steps.title: Deployment & CI/CD
steps.description: Deploy full-stack applications to platforms like Vercel, Render, or AWS with SSL.

title: Data Analyst Learning Roadmap
description: Step-by-step path to collecting, processing, analyzing, and visualizing business data.

steps.title: Master Advanced Excel & Spreadsheet Modeling
steps.description: Learn VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, and statistical functions.

steps.title: SQL Data Extraction & Querying
steps.description: Master SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOINs, subqueries, and window functions.

steps.title: Python for Data Analysis (Pandas & NumPy)
steps.description: Clean raw data, manipulate series and dataframes, and automate calculations.

steps.title: Data Visualization Tools (Tableau / Power BI)
steps.description: Build interactive business intelligence dashboards and executive reports.

title: Data Scientist Learning Roadmap
description: From statistical modeling to building machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics.

steps.title: Advanced Mathematics & Statistics
steps.description: Master linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability, and hypothesis testing.

steps.title: Python & Data Science Ecosystem
steps.description: Master Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn for statistical computing.

steps.title: Applied Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn)
steps.description: Implement regression, classification, clustering, PCA, and cross-validation.

steps.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
steps.description: Learn convolutional and recurrent neural networks using PyTorch or TensorFlow.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Bridge data science and software engineering to deploy production-scale AI models.

steps.title: Production Python & Algorithms
steps.description: Master object-oriented Python, memory management, and data structures.

steps.title: Deep Learning & Model Optimization
steps.description: Build custom PyTorch models, optimize hyperparameters, and tune model architectures.

steps.title: MLOps & Model Deployment
steps.description: Serve models via REST APIs (FastAPI), use MLflow for tracking, and deploy with Docker.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst Learning Roadmap
description: Protect enterprise infrastructure from threat actors through network defense and incident response.

steps.title: Computer Networking & Linux Fundamentals
steps.description: Understand OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and Linux command-line administration.

steps.title: Security Fundamentals & Threat Analysis
steps.description: Learn cryptography, malware analysis, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners.

steps.title: Penetration Testing & Ethical Hacking
steps.description: Practice with Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, and Burp Suite on lab networks.

title: Cloud Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Design, deploy, and manage scalable cloud computing environments.

steps.title: Linux Systems Administration & Networking
steps.description: Master Bash scripting, SSH, systemd, and IP subnetting.

steps.title: AWS / Azure Cloud Core Services
steps.description: Learn Compute (EC2), Storage (S3), Networking (VPC), and Security (IAM).

steps.title: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
steps.description: Automate cloud provisioning using declarative HCL scripts.

title: DevOps Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Automate software pipelines and build continuous integration and continuous deployment environments.

steps.title: Containerization (Docker)
steps.description: Build Dockerfiles, manage multi-container apps with Docker Compose.

steps.title: Container Orchestration (Kubernetes)
steps.description: Deploy pods, services, ingress controllers, and Helm charts.

steps.title: CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions / Jenkins)
steps.description: Write automated workflow YAML files for testing and deployment.

title: UI/UX Designer Learning Roadmap
description: Master user experience research, visual interface design, and interactive prototyping.

steps.title: UX Research & Design Principles
steps.description: Understand design thinking, typography, color theory, grid systems, and accessibility.

steps.title: Figma Mastery & Wireframing
steps.description: Create low-fidelity wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, auto-layout components, and design systems.

steps.title: Usability Testing & Portfolio Creation
steps.description: Conduct prototype testing with real users, document design case studies, and launch a portfolio.

title: Mechanical Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Path from fundamental physics to advanced CAD design and thermal machinery manufacturing.

steps.title: Engineering Physics & Calculus
steps.description: Master Newtonian mechanics, vector calculus, and differential equations.

steps.title: Thermodynamics & Material Science
steps.description: Study energy laws, fluid dynamics, stress-strain relations, and material selection.

steps.title: Computer-Aided Design (SolidWorks / AutoCAD)
steps.description: Design 3D mechanical parts, assemblies, and run Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations.

title: Civil Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Master structural analysis, geotechnical surveying, and infrastructure project execution.

steps.title: Statics, Dynamics & Fluid Mechanics
steps.description: Calculate forces, beam deflections, and fluid behavior in pipes and open channels.

steps.title: Structural Concrete & Steel Design
steps.description: Learn reinforced concrete design, steel frame connections, and building safety codes.

steps.title: AutoCAD & Civil 3D Surveying
steps.description: Master 2D structural drafting, site layout planning, and BIM software.

title: Electrical Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: From electric circuit analysis to embedded systems programming and power grid systems.

steps.title: Circuit Analysis & Signals
steps.description: Master Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's laws, AC/DC analysis, and Fourier transformations.

steps.title: Digital Electronics & Microcontrollers
steps.description: Study logic gates, FPGA design, ARM microcontrollers, and C programming.

title: Medical Doctor (Physician) Roadmap
description: Rigorous medical education path from pre-med biology to clinical residency training.

steps.title: Pre-Medical Undergraduate Studies
steps.description: Complete foundational coursework in General Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biology, and Physics.

steps.title: Medical School (M.D. / M.B.B.S.)
steps.description: Master Human Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, and clinical rotations.

steps.title: Clinical Residency Training
steps.description: Complete supervised hospital residency in your chosen medical specialty.

title: Registered Nurse (RN) Learning Roadmap
description: Comprehensive nursing education, clinical practice hours, and licensure path.

steps.title: Nursing School (BSN or ADN Degree)
steps.description: Study Anatomy, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Nursing Ethics, and Clinical Skills.

steps.title: Pass the NCLEX-RN Licensure Exam
steps.description: Prepare for national nursing licensure through comprehensive practice testing.

title: Pharmacist Learning Roadmap
description: Academic and clinical journey to becoming a licensed Doctor of Pharmacy.

steps.title: Pharm.D. Degree Program
steps.description: Complete coursework in Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmacokinetics, and Therapeutics.

steps.title: Pharmacy Licensure Exams (NAPLEX & MPJE)
steps.description: Pass national pharmacy board examinations and state pharmacy law exams.

title: Chartered Accountant (CA / CPA) Roadmap
description: Rigorous accounting coursework, practical articleship, and professional qualification exams.

steps.title: Foundational Accounting & Business Law
steps.description: Pass introductory examinations in financial accounting, mercantile law, and economics.

steps.title: Practical Articleship / Auditing Internship
steps.description: Complete mandatory practical training under a licensed Chartered Accountant firm.

steps.title: Final Professional Examination & Certification
steps.description: Pass advanced financial reporting, strategic financial management, and corporate law finals.

title: Financial Analyst Learning Roadmap
description: Master financial modeling, corporate valuation, and investment management.

steps.title: Corporate Finance Fundamentals
steps.description: Study income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and financial ratios.

steps.title: Financial Modeling in Excel
steps.description: Build 3-statement models, DCF valuations, LBO models, and sensitivity analyses.

steps.title: CPA / CFA Charter Preparation
steps.description: Prepare for Level I, II, and III CFA examinations covering portfolio management and ethics.

title: Digital Marketer Learning Roadmap
description: Master SEO, paid ad acquisition, content marketing, and conversion funnel optimization.

steps.title: SEO & Content Marketing Fundamentals
steps.description: Learn keyword research, on-page SEO, technical site audits, and content creation.

steps.title: Paid Ad Search & Social (Google Ads / Meta Ads)
steps.description: Configure pay-per-click ad groups, audience targeting, conversion pixel tracking, and A/B testing.

title: Educator / Teacher Learning Roadmap
description: Path to mastering subject pedagogy, classroom management, and teaching certification.

steps.title: Subject Domain & Educational Psychology
steps.description: Master your academic subject specialization and cognitive learning theories.

steps.title: Student Teaching Internship & Certification
steps.description: Complete supervised student teaching hours and pass state teacher certification exams.

title: Research Scientist Learning Roadmap
description: Formulate hypotheses, design empirical experiments, and publish peer-reviewed papers.

steps.title: Undergraduate & Master's Research Foundation
steps.description: Conduct laboratory experiments, write literature reviews, and master lab equipment.

steps.title: Ph.D. Dissertation & Peer-Reviewed Publishing
steps.description: Execute original scientific research, publish articles, and defend your doctoral thesis.
